label: Query Workbench
type: the web-console SQL++ editor, which supplies txid and tximplicit implicitly
recurrence_note: 8 -> 9 in round 20, first contact on the tool's own canonical Server reference page (query-workbench.md) - all eight prior attestations came from Capella pages describing the same web-console feature.
evidence: The Query Workbench only runs on nodes which are running the Query service.
In either case, you do not need to specify the `txid` parameter or the `tximplicit` parameter.
Note that in Couchbase Server Community Edition, index advice is provided in a different way.
note: Round 20 also found query-workbench.md's own Import/Export buttons (for saved queries/history/results) name-collide with the unrelated tool:cbimport/tool:cbexport (bulk document data CLI tools) - flagged shouldNotBeConfusedWith on the page's own extraction record. Same word, two products' worth of unrelated meaning within one tool's UI.
